answer: Under the copper, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. Every identity posts a refundable stake on entry, and the stake only vests back while its grading record stays clean — junk or spam forfeits it. The kernel gate means a clone farm must lock real capital per fake, and misbehaving clones bleed that capital instead of earning it back. The canyon does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
